subject: Re: DPA redlines & subprocessor exception needed for Acme Payments rollout
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: james.oneill@acmepayments.com, procurement@acmepayments.com
Cc: legal@acmepayments.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA redlines for go-live - Acme Payments (ACME-4521)

Hi James / Acme team,

Thanks again for the productive call last week. Attached is Redwood's latest DPA redline (Acme_DPA_redline_v3.pdf) — we incorporated your earlier comment on data retention and tightened the subprocessor section to list the specific providers we'll use. Two quick notes:

- We can accept your liability cap adjustment in §6 but need to preserve the breach notification timelines in §4.
- One subprocessor (LogStream Inc.) remains flagged in our list; they operate EU-hosted TLS endpoints and require an exception for cross-border processing.

Our planned go-live for the pilot is June 21 and procurement would like DocuSign in place before then. If LogStream's inclusion is a blocker, we can route traffic to an alternate ingestion path but that may add ~2 weeks to setup.

Please review the attached redline and let me know if your legal team can sign or if you want us to prepare a DocuSign envelope once exceptions are cleared.

Best,

Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0132

Attachment: Acme_DPA_redline_v3.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: subprocessors_list.csv (csv)

From: James O'Neill <james.oneill@acmepayments.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPA redlines for go-live - Acme Payments (ACME-4521)

Laura, thanks for the redline — quick readthrough from Acme Legal:

- We can accept the edits to §6 if Redwood adds explicit indemnity language for third-party processors handling PI.
- The bigger issue: LogStream shows as a subprocessor; Acme requires either (a) that subprocessors be EU-resident with SCCs in place, or (b) explicit CISO-level approval documented as an exception.

Our security team flagged LogStream because their SOC docs reference data residency in Ireland but also allow failover to US regions. Can Redwood confirm (1) whether LogStream will have a contractual SCC + exporter controls, and (2) whether you can route our tenant to an EU-only instance?

Procurement wants to avoid an exception if possible — otherwise we'll need an SLA/penalty addendum. We are timing this for a June 22 pilot QAT, so this is time-sensitive.

Regards,
James
Head of Procurement, Acme Payments
Procurement Team
Attachment: Acme_redline_comments.pdf

From: priyom.das@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: DPA redlines - LogStream subprocessor exception request

Laura — forwarding Acme's response. Short analysis:

- LogStream is in our approved subprocessor roster but its reseller agreement allows cross-region failover; our standard SCC + DPA with LogStream do not explicitly carve out EU-only residency guarantees.
- Risk posture: moderate. Security prefers we route Acme to our EU ingress cluster (we have that capability) but Product/Infra estimates 3 business days of routing config and QA.

Requesting exec-level exception routing: 1) approve temporary exception to accept LogStream on SCC/T&C + 2) commit to routing Acme to EU ingress by 2027-06-11. Acme needs DocuSign before June 21.

If execs won't sign, procurement may insist on SLA penalties which could affect margin on ACME-4521.

Priyom
Sr. Commercial Ops, Redwood

>> Original message attached for context

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: legal@acmepayments.com, james.oneill@acmepayments.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 12:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA redlines for go-live - Acme Payments (ACME-4521)

Hi James / Acme Legal —

Thanks for the callout. To be fully transparent: LogStream is a vendor we use for streaming ingestion; we have SCCs in place and an executed DPA with them, but their contract does permit emergency failover to non-EU regions. To address Acme's requirement, Redwood will:

1) Prepare a routing configuration so your tenant is explicitly pinned to our EU ingress cluster (we will isolate the tenant so failover does not move to US routes).
2) Share LogStream's SCC/attestation documents and confirm contractual DPA language with them (attached: redline_summary_notes.txt).
3) If Acme still requires it, Redwood will negotiate a short addendum limiting failover for your tenant only (we can escalate to LogStream).

Next steps: I can prepare a DocuSign envelope once we have CISO/escalation approval for the temporary exception and a firm commit date for EU routing (target: 2027-06-11). Priyom — can you confirm whether infra can meet the 3 business day routing/QA window if we start today?

Thanks,
Laura

Attachment: redline_summary_notes.txt

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: DPA redlines - request for exec exception

Looping in CISO: Evelyn, this is an APAC/US customer on a US-entity contract but routing must be EU-only for their payment processing tenant. Priyom states infra can do 3 business days of work to pin the tenant.

Decision needed: approve exception to accept LogStream for this tenant while we implement tenant-level EU pinning. Conditions I propose:
- Redwood provides LogStream SCCs and recent SOC2 report to Acme legal within 24 hours.
- Redwood commits to EU-only tenant routing by 2027-06-11 and validates via acceptance test.
- Exception expires automatically if routing not validated by 2027-06-14.

If approved, Laura: proceed to prepare DocuSign with the redline we've agreed and include the exception terms above. Procurement/Legal at Acme need documented assurance before we sign.

Rishi
VP, Sales Operations

From: legal@acmepayments.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, james.oneill@acmepayments.com
Cc: procurement@acmepayments.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: DPA redlines for go-live - Acme Payments (ACME-4521)

Laura — appreciate the quick follow-up and proposed conditions. Our legal/security is fine with the path forward subject to the following:

1) We need to review LogStream's SCC and SOC2 artifacts before DocuSign.
2) Contractual addendum limiting failover for Acme's tenant only, signed or in-flight at time of DocuSign.

If Redwood can deliver the SCC + SOC2 and confirm the EU pinning schedule by EOD Friday (2027-06-11 UTC), we will proceed with DocuSign and aim to sign the DPA the same week. Please send the artifacts and a DocuSign link once the exception terms are added.

Thanks,
Marta Kovac
Senior Counsel, Acme Payments
Attachment: Acme_security_checklist.xlsx
